reason: Missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when `buf` is provided. The fix is uuid >=11.1.1 and the installed copy is 9.0.1 — TWO majors below it — pinned by google-auth-library inside firebase-admin's dependency chain, which this repo does not control. A pnpm override to 11.x would force a cross-major HTTP-auth dependency change under the push stack, which is exactly the class of override SUPPLY-CHAIN G4 refused to make. Bimoto passes no caller-controlled `buf` to uuid.

reason: Unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation (CVE-2026-54285, GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf). RE-ISSUED UNDER A NEW ADVISORY ID: this is the same defect this file has carried since SUPPLY-CHAIN as 1120821, which the registry has since retired in favour of 1145811 — same package, same title, same fix. The guard's stale rule caught the swap and failed the build, which is the rule working: an entry keyed on an id nobody publishes any more attests nothing. NO PATCH-BUMP IS AVAILABLE, checked rather than assumed: the fix is >=2.8.0 and 1.30.1 is the LAST 1.x release the registry has, so there is no same-major version to move to. 1.30.1 is pinned by @sentry/node 8.x and by every one of its @opentelemetry/instrumentation-* packages, which expect the 1.x API; an override to 2.x would break Sentry's instrumentation rather than move a version. REVISIT: at the Sentry 8 -> 10 migration, or sooner if the severity moves off moderate — the guard fails on a severity change by itself, so that revisit is enforced rather than remembered.
